completion_data.completion_summary: Re-ingested wijesekera_1990_constructivemodallogicsi via a new bespoke reflow tool (154 shredded chunks -> 38 clean chunks, 1669.5B mean, 5.3% under 300B), with Definitions 1.1.1-1.1.4 and the box/diamond independence statement verified complete via literature-search.sh. Hardened literature-convert.sh's shared no-TOC heading heuristic with an independent structural signal plus a broadened OCR-producer detector, and added a non-blocking pathological-mean-chunk-size guard to literature-ingest.sh; both changes verified non-regressive against a corpus sample.

memory_candidates.content: literature-chunk.sh's atomic-block protection (is_atomic_start()) only applies at the TOP-LEVEL heading-chunk boundary -- it checks a heading-chunk's own first line/title, never per-paragraph within a larger section. A reflow/heading-insertion tool bypassing literature-convert.sh for a badly-OCR'd document must therefore keep an atomic statement's (Definition/Lemma/Theorem/Proof) own nested enumerated sub-items ((1)/(2)/(3), (i)-(viii)) glued into ONE paragraph, not split at each numbered sub-item -- otherwise Pass-2's size-based merge can land a chunk boundary mid-statement even though the statement itself is short. A one-line-lookahead blank-line-suppression rule is also needed: this document's typesetting surrounds centered math-display inserts with a single blank line purely as visual spacing, and a naive blank-line-always-ends-paragraph rule still fragments the enclosing statement even after fixing the enumerated-marker polarity.

When testing whether a literature-convert.sh no-TOC heading-heuristic change (is_heading_candidate/derive_heuristic_markdown) regresses a corpus document, check the actual '[convert] Engine used: ...' log line before trusting an empirical stat comparison -- many documents route through the primary pymupdf4llm tier or the TOC-present derive_toc_markdown() path under normal auto-mode operation, both of which never call the modified functions at all, making the regression risk structurally zero rather than merely empirically observed. Force LITERATURE_CONVERTER=fallback to directly exercise and compare the modified fallback-tier heuristic in isolation when a document's auto-mode conversion doesn't naturally reach it.

literature-search.sh's load_fidelity_map() only recognizes the older index.json 'path: sources/...' schema (it derives a doc-directory name by stripping a sources/ prefix); entries using the newer doc_id/chunks_dir schema (no path field) are silently skipped, so their real provenance_fidelity is never found and get_fidelity()'s fail-open default (unverified_summary) wrongly quarantines them from default do_search() results, since unverified_summary is in QUARANTINED_FIDELITY_VALUES. Affects any document ingested/updated with the newer schema, confirmed on at least two corpus documents. Workaround: pass --include-unverified. Not yet fixed as of this writing.
